rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) equated with mūla-kaulam (root Kaula)

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: Eight accomplishments are enumerated in this context.
The attainment of these accomplishments is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis is declared to be the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight siddhis is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
